parole.significato: ibis (bird of genus Plegadis and more generally of family Threskiornithidae)
parole.testo: Transliteration of Ancient Greek ἶβις (îbis), of Egyptian origin.

parole.significato: oasis (spring of fresh water, surrounded by a fertile region of vegetation, in a desert)
parole.testo: Derived from Ancient Greek Ὄασις (Óasis), borrowed from Egyptian wḥꜣt.
